{{Top|leg}}
A '''sterika''' was a close bond between two members of the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adner]]. The bond was always between members of the same [[steris]], the name for an Adnerem family, and entirely non-sexual, but the Adnerem would become so close they thought of themselves as a single entity. At any one time, about ten percent of the Adnerem population was in a sterika, and while Adnerem did not actively seek a partner to form a sterika with&mdash;as other species sought love&mdash;those Adnerem not in a sterika often appeared envious of the close bond between those who were. It was incredibly rare for Adnerem to form any other kind of strong emotional attachment to a living being.
